samples.text: YOU OVERHEAR THE MAGE TELL HIS COMPANION, 'HOW MUCH LONGER MUST WE WAIT BEFORE ASSAULTING PHLAN. I AM EAGER TO BECOME A BARON.'
YOU FIND LEX GEOGRAPHICA, AN ATLAS DRAWN BY TOMARUS. IT HAS A MAP OF PHLAN WHICH, THOUGH OLD, STILL COULD BE USEFUL. IT BECOMES ENTRY 37 IN YOUR JOURNAL.
YOU HAVE ENTERED THE MONSTER-CRAWLING SLUMS OF PHLAN.  SMALL, UGLY THINGS SCURRY FROM BENEATH YOUR FEET.  IN THE DISTANCE, AN ALARM SOUNDS.
'GREETINGS, COURAGEOUS ONES, I AM ROLF, APPOINTED BY THE COUNCIL TO INTRODUCE NEWCOMERS TO THE FAIR CITY OF PHLAN. IF YOU WILL ACCOMPANY ME, I WILL START THE TOUR.'
'YOU NOW FACE AN ENTRANCE TO THE TEMPLE OF TYR.  THERE ARE THREE TEMPLES IN PHLAN: TYR'S, SUNE'S, AND TEMPUS. TYR'S IS THE LARGEST AND HOUSES BISHOP BRACCIO. IF YOU WILL TURN AROUND NOW, '
'ON YOUR RIGHT IS ONE OF THE ENTRANCE'S TO SUNE'S TEMPLE. AS WITH ALL PHLAN'S TEMPLES, VARIOUS CLERICAL SERVICES ARE OFFERED INSIDE.  ON YOUR LEFT IS AN ENTRANCE TO THE CITY PARK.'

SOME HOBGOBLINS ARE ARGUING OVER A PILE OF GOLD.  'THIEVES!' THEY SCREAM WHEN THEY SEE YOU.
THE COUNCIL WAS PLEASED BY THE ELIMINATION OF THE THIEVES IN KOVEL MANSION.
A LARGE GROUP OF THIEVES OPERATES OUT OF THE OLD KOVEL MANSION. THE COUNCIL WILL PAY TO HAVE THEM CLEANED OUT.'

AS YOU NEAR THE PILE OF WEAPONS AN AWFUL SMELLING CLOUD OF GAS FORMS.  THIS FOUL SMELLING GAS STUNS THE PARTY ALLOWING A GROUP OF THIEVES TO JUMP OUT OF THE SHADOWS AND ATTACK AT WILL!
STANDING READY THEIR LEADER SAYS 'YOU MUST BE THE SERVANTS OF YARASH!'
